fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: A yank that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Exposed] and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and spreads your afflictions on it to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Over the Head
fusions.desc: Flings a cloth over a target up to 4 tiles away for 3 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drape and Vanish
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Deep Pockets
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
